msg: MinIO server image. The minio/minio GitHub repository is archived and its README says it is no longer maintained; the last community release is RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z and the community edition is now source-only, so this image gets no updates.
fix: image: chrislusf/seaweedfs:4.48 (Apache-2.0, released 2026-09-28) with entrypoint weed.

msg: Builds MinIO from source, the only community path left. MinIO is AGPL-3.0 since the commit "update license change for MinIO" of 2021-04-23, and its README says all usage requires validation against AGPLv3 obligations, including release of modified code.
fix: Build or pull SeaweedFS instead (Apache-2.0): chrislusf/seaweedfs:4.48, or go install github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/weed@latest.

msg: minio server command. SeaweedFS has no minio binary; one process can run master, volume server, filer and the S3 gateway.
fix: entrypoint: weed · command: server -dir=/data -s3 (or weed s3 -filer=filer:8888 for a split setup).

msg: MinIO Console setting. SeaweedFS has no MinIO Console; its web admin is a separate process.
fix: weed admin -masters=master:9333 (Admin UI, default port 23646) and drop the 9001 port mapping.

msg: MinIO root credentials. SeaweedFS does not read MINIO_* variables, so the gateway starts without these keys.
fix: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (read only when no -config is given), or an s3.json identity with actions ["Admin","Read","Write"] passed as -s3.config.

msg: Port 9000 is MinIO's S3 API port. The SeaweedFS S3 gateway listens on 8333 by default.
fix: Map 8333:8333, or start with -s3.port=9000 to keep the old client port.

msg: Client endpoint points at the MinIO service.
fix: Point it at http://seaweedfs:8333 and keep path-style addressing unless the gateway runs with -domainName.

msg: mc admin calls the MinIO admin API, which SeaweedFS does not implement.
fix: SeaweedFS implements the IAM API on the S3 endpoint: aws iam create-user --endpoint-url http://seaweedfs:8333, or list identities in s3.json.

msg: Bucket notification. SeaweedFS lists GetBucketNotificationConfiguration and PutBucketNotificationConfiguration as not supported, so this consumer stops receiving events.
fix: Move the consumer to SeaweedFS filer metadata events (weed filer.meta.tail -pathPrefix=/buckets/<bucket>) or a ListObjectsV2 poll, and test it before cutover.

msg: MinIO replication. SeaweedFS lists GetBucketReplication, PutBucketReplication and DeleteBucketReplication as not supported.
fix: weed filer.sync -a=<filerA>:8888 -b=<filerB>:8888 (resumable continuous sync between two clusters).

msg: Lifecycle transition to a remote tier. SeaweedFS supports PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration, but transition rules are not supported.
fix: Keep expiry rules only (--expire-days) and plan cold-tier moves outside the S3 lifecycle API.

msg: S3 Select. SeaweedFS lists SelectObjectContent as not supported.
fix: GET the object and filter it in the job (DuckDB, pandas, jq).

msg: MinIO KMS/KES setting. SeaweedFS SSE-KMS talks to AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS or OpenBao/Vault, not to KES.
fix: Point SSE-KMS at OpenBao/Vault and copy encrypted objects through the S3 API (read from MinIO, write to SeaweedFS), never the drive folders.

msg: MINIO_DOMAIN turns on virtual-host style bucket URLs.
fix: weed s3 -domainName=<suffix> (or -s3.domainName with weed server) for {bucket}.{domainName} URLs.

msg: MinIO OpenID or LDAP identity provider.
fix: SeaweedFS STS supports AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity and AssumeRoleWithLDAPIdentity; configure it in the advanced IAM file passed as -iam.config.

msg: MinIO health endpoint; SeaweedFS serves its health check on /healthz and /status instead.
MinIO on-disk format (.minio.sys, xl.meta). SeaweedFS cannot read MinIO data folders.
fix: Copy through the S3 API with rclone sync or mc mirror from MinIO to the SeaweedFS endpoint, then compare object counts.
